Use only the retrieved items. Do not use outside knowledge and do not reason

  dates, places, who did what, qualifiers).
- contradicted: some item gives a different value for the same specific, such
  as another year or another person.
- missing: neither of the above.
If one item states the fact and another contradicts it, the status is contradicted.

Evidence for stated or contradicted facts: copy one continuous passage from

item's number. Never join separate words into a quote that does not appear as

what, numbers, dates, reasons); a quote that only sets the topic, or stops

We are going straight to the top of the org chart, folks. Google CEO Sundar Pichai and Epic CEO Tim Sweeney are absolutely expected to attend. I’d say quite a bit! For example:

Epic says it’s not in this for the money, it’s only suing to end Google’s monopoly — but Epic would surely profit if it doesn’t have to pay Google’s cut.

It looks like Epic’s going to argue that you’re locked into Android after buying an Android phone, but I can personally attest that switching back and forth between the platforms is easier than ever.

What to know about Fortnite maker Epic Games’ antitrust battle with Google, starting today (TechCrunch, 2023-11-06T16:47:11+00:00)

Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy. A second trial is scheduled for March 2024, with additional charges.

Before his fall, Bankman-Fried made himself out to be the Good Boy of crypto — the trustworthy face of a sometimes-shady industry. He was also very interested in publicity, sitting for many interviews both before and after the fall of FTX. The quick rise of FTX as an industry force was at least in part due to Bankman-Fried’s appetite for attention.

The all-hands took place the following day, and was secretly recorded by an employee who’d joined Alameda three days before.

In the recording, Ellison did indeed confess to stealing customer funds with Bankman-Fried’s approval. Drappi said he resigned less than 24 hours after the meeting. The recording was later sent to Drappi, who sent it to the government.

Christian Everdell, one of Bankman-Fried’s defense attorneys, couldn’t undo the damage of last week’s code review. Bankman-Fried told Ellison it was “really important,” otherwise “Binance would do things to mess with FTX.” Ellison says she told him Alameda didn’t have the money.
